notes.title: Surpassed 20000 downloads!
notes.content:
As of December 17, 2023, "Real-time Assist Replay Time - One Minute till Closing Time" has surpassed 20000 downloads. We deeply appreciate the many people who have downloaded and played our game. We have been carefully reviewing the feedback and reviews, and all of us at "HonwakaFuwafuwa" use them as reference for improvements.

We appreciate your continued support for "Real-time Assist Replay Time - One Minute till Closing Time". Thank you.

notes.title: V3.1.0 Update: Added 'Zettai Meirei☆UPUP!?' by VTuber 'NekomaShiroa'
notes.content:
We are the circle "Honwaka Fuwafuwa."

"Real-Time Assist Replay Time　～1 minute until closing～"
We have updated to Version 3.1.0.

The details are as follows:

■ Update Contents

・New Song Added
[previewyoutube=cLla1XFG3nw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
We added "Zettai Meirei☆UPUP!? / NekomaShiroa." It can be set from the BGM settings on the left side of the screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43729605/a01d984bce940f5399e5af09df4f7804830048d3.png[/img]
・Pause Menu can be displayed by pressing Enter during Normal Mode and 777 Mode play.

You can also navigate from the pause menu using keyboard controls. This should enhance the game's retry functionality.

・Added checkboxes next to each end card thumbnail on the end card screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43729605/a5bce29f06e7fb889b086114b46439ef9dd6414a.png[/img]
By default, all end card checkboxes are selected. If you uncheck them, the end cards will no longer appear in the result screen during Normal Mode, 777 Mode, and Endless Mode play. This allows you to increase the appearance rate of your favorite end card. If all are turned off, the behavior is the same as if all are turned on.

Thank you.
We appreciate your continued support of "Real-time Assist Replay Time One Minute Until Closing."

notes.title: 11,111 downloads hit! Our game ad's live at Hachioji Station, Jul 26-Aug 25, '23
notes.content:
Our ad will be aired at "Hachioji Station North Exit Vision" (http://cra1964.co.jp/OOH/) from July 26 to August 25, 2023.

"Hachioji Station North Exit Vision" is a digital billboard located above the 2nd floor entrance of "Hachioji Square Building," directly across the rotary from JR Hachioji Station's north exit.

There are two versions of the video, each broadcast at the following times. The background music is the song "Everyone Be Friends - Elementary School Anthem" by the VTuber "Makino Monaka," which is also used in the game.

●Broadcast times (6:00~23:00)
Pattern 1: From 5 minutes and 45 seconds past every hour
Pattern 2: From 35 minutes and 45 seconds past every hour

●Video information
BGM: Kakuinakayoku-Shogakko
Singer: Monaka Makino  (https://twitter.com/monaka_0_0_7)
└Avatar2.0 Project (https://avatar2-0.jp/)

Narration:
Pattern 1: Sayo Izumi (https://twitter.com/sayoyoyo0719)
Pattern 2: Nako Natsuki (https://twitter.com/nutsnaco)

notes.title: LINE Stickers Now Available!
notes.content:
We have started selling LINE stickers featuring charming characters from "Real-Time Assist Replay Time (abbr.)" and other heartwarming, fluffy designs.

If you've grown attached to the game, please consider purchasing these stickers. We believe they can be used in a variety of situations, from 9:30 AM to 10:49 PM. The illustrations are all new and drawn by "Heiwa Nabe," who also worked on the game's artwork.
